description: This file defines API routes for authentication in a FastAPI application, including registration, login, and fetching current user info. It uses dependency injection for database sessions and user authentication, and interacts with user services and JWT token creation.

methods.name: register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles user registration by processing POST requests to /register, registering a new user and returning user info.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token in response to POST requests to /login.

methods.name: me(user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's info on GET requests to /me.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session/

ctags.name: me
ctags.pattern: /^def me(user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session)):$/
